status: selected engineering contract; physical qualification pending
authority: Owner permits a lower rate when the chosen ICs cannot feasibly support 1 MHz; engineering selection follows the completed CP1-R2 readiness study.

clock.instruction_rate: Variable: microcycle rate divided by the executed instruction's microcycle count.
clock.rate_change_policy: A different oscillator/rate requires a versioned contract and affected verification. No automatic fallback or live clock switching is accepted.

supply.measurement_point: At each IC's supply and ground pins, including droop, ripple and distribution drop.

startup_reset.boundary: Externally qualified reset until the separate supervisor/write-inhibit design is accepted.
startup_reset.release_conditions: Supply is continuously valid at every IC; oscillator startup has elapsed and its qualified waveform is stable. Any loss of validity restarts the guard.
startup_reset.abort: Asynchronous reset may truncate a cycle. Inhibit writes and bus output enables; no partly executed operation may be treated as completed. RAM contents are unspecified after an interrupted write.
startup_reset.initialization: Run the oscillator during reset so resetless registers initialize. Permit the documented first invalid microcycle; the first valid microcycle must be fetch-address, without skipping it.
startup_reset.power_invalid: Write inhibition must become effective before any IC leaves the valid supply envelope; supervisor threshold, propagation and rail fall-rate headroom need separate qualification.

modes.stop: Finish an accepted cycle after synchronization; enter idle within four nominal microcycles after a valid stop request. HALT remains latched until explicit RESUME.
modes.single_step: One debounced STEP edge while READY and idle produces exactly one complete microcycle. Holding STEP must not repeat. STEP during ACTIVE is ignored.
modes.mode_change: Clock replacement or frequency changes only with power removed; qualify startup again. Raw mechanical switch bounce is not an accepted control input.

timing_acceptance.setup_reserve_scope: Design criterion for inter-register and connector capture paths after worst-case device delays, skew, routing, jitter and measurement uncertainty; not a measured margin.
timing_acceptance.hold_release: Every device hold, recovery/removal and pulse requirement must pass with positive residual margin after uncertainty. Demonstrate break-before-make at shared drivers and SRAM handover; slowing the clock is not a substitute.
timing_acceptance.electrical: Use guaranteed bounds at the actual supply, temperature, load and input slew, or explicitly reviewed sample-qualification bounds. Typical values and allocations alone cannot close qualification.
timing_acceptance.allocation_scope: Sensitivity/design limits only. ACH 45/55 duty at half supply does not guarantee receiver-threshold duty or jitter.

qualification_matrix.digital_scope: A requested future full matrix. Existing R2 CPU/clock matrices have their archived coverage; this contract does not claim all Cartesian combinations have run.

physical_tests.stimulus: Cold start, slow and nonmonotonic rail ramps, brownout and reset release
physical_tests.pass: No writes before valid supply/clock and the full restartable guard; defined initialization; no spurious functional capture.

physical_tests.stimulus: Continuous clock, stop at each phase, HALT/RESUME, held STEP and STEP during ACTIVE
physical_tests.pass: Qualified frequency/duty/edges; no runt or extra phases outside explicit reset abort; safe idle; stop within the contract limit; exact single-step count.

physical_tests.stimulus: Same-word PC/SP-to-MAR memory reads, ALU/register captures, counter ripple/load and all source/destination combinations
physical_tests.pass: At least the contract setup reserve after uncertainty; all hold, pulse and recovery/removal requirements have positive residual margin; correct captured data.

physical_tests.stimulus: Opposing-data and same-data source/trunk handovers, DATA release, reset during drive
physical_tests.pass: No simultaneous enabled shared drivers; load-qualified release before reuse; connector hold maintained; no floating-input dependence.

physical_tests.stimulus: Read/write/read transitions, address changes, shortest writes and reset during writes at actual DQ loads
physical_tests.pass: No unintended write pulse or driver overlap; qualified loaded release; datasheet write/read limits with positive residual margin.

physical_tests.stimulus: Repeated startup and the selected first-machine diagnostics/workload
physical_tests.pass: Exact documented register/memory/IO results without host bootstrap injection; no intermittent failure. IO scope and repetition counts are defined by their owning tasks before bench acceptance.
